checks.name: Production pure policy is exactly the candidate except header/import; UI and normal physical/light/audio paths remain limited
Direct owned observation capture selects actual saved leftDISPLAY6/1270 and preserves explicit/manual choice
QA/frozen/quality/benchmark/interrupted locks defer both selection and refresh without output side effects
Deferred native fetch coalesces and latest own geometry is sampled after resolution
User/options/geometry/report changes during setEnabled cannot publish stale calibration or notification UI
Geometry change during transform await cannot publish stale transform/HDR labels; latest pending apply succeeds
Unchanged observation poll performs no work; changed same-name/same-peak device changes identity signature
Actual frame guards pause normal scene while selection applies and error paths release applying without false final calibration

evidence.errorRetryPolicy: Current production may deliberately surface an error; no automatic retry or readiness is inferred by this test

scope: Eight focused cases execute actual extracted production observation/guard/key/poll/refresh/apply and constructor-notification methods using CPU spies/deferred promises. No live screen, native report refresh, HDR transport or renderer is used.
